abilities.name: Spring Spirit Summoning

variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: Hold variant cooldownStartDelay is 32 frames (gcsim: skillHoldCDStart+1 = 32); AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field — reviewer to add schema support or document separately.

gcsim comment on ActionSkill for Hold frames: '// assume skill (press)'; gcsim also notes 'skill (hold) -> skill (hold) is 52 frames'. The ActionSkill value (45) reflects H→Press, not H→Hold. Reviewer to verify whether H→H (52f) warrants a separate entry.

Icy Quill mechanic: Shenhe's E applies Icy Quill to all party members (Press: 5 stacks/10s; Hold: 7 stacks/15s). On each Cryo DMG hit from a party member, 1 stack is consumed and flat DMG equal to (skillpp multiplier × Shenhe's current ATK) is added — this is an ATK-scaling buff. [A7b] AUTHORED 2026-07-20 (implement-first, verifier-specced): team normalFlatDmg buff scaling 82.2% of the caster's ATK (sidecar 'DMG Bonus' row, TL10), Press 10s on the base effects / Hold 15s on the hE variant — the Escoffier C2 / Yun Jin single-class shape (Cryo-only filter and 5/7-quill consumption not enforced; surfaced in the caveat). C6 exempts Normal and Charged Attack Cryo hits from consuming stacks.

Spirit Communion Seal (A4) lives HERE and on the hE variant, not on the passive (2026-09-17, T1.5): a passive cannot tell a press from a hold, and a variant's `effects` REPLACE the base's, so the split is free. gcsim asc.go: press → +15% Elemental Skill/Burst DMG to every party member for 10s; hold → +15% Normal/Charged/Plunging DMG for 15s.

Icy Quill on all five `*FlatDmg` classes (2026-09-17, T1.5; was `normalFlatDmg` only, which read as 'my burst is not buffed'). gcsim quillDamageMod adds the flat DMG to any Cryo hit — normal, charged, plunge, skill, hold skill and burst. The team row pools the five stats and A4 into one bar per cast.
abilities.description:
The frosted dew, silvery and dense, shall exorcise all demons.
Grants all nearby party members the Icy Quill effect and deals Cryo DMG in different ways based on whether it is pressed or held.

Press
Rushes forward together with a Talisman Spirit, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents along the path.

Hold
Commands the Talisman Spirit to deal AoE Cryo DMG.

Icy Quill
When Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts deal Cryo DMG to opponents, the DMG dealt is increased based on Shenhe's current ATK.

The Icy Quill's effects will be cleared once its duration ends or after being triggered a certain number of times. When held rather than pressed, the Icy Quill's effect lasts longer and can be triggered more times.
When one Cryo DMG instance strikes multiple opponents, the effect is triggered multiple times based on the number of opponents hit. The number of times the effect is triggered is calculated independently for each party member with the Icy Quill.
abilities.caveat: Shown for the full duration; in game each Cryo hit consumes 1 of 5 quills (7 if held), except Normal and Charged Attacks at C6. Only Cryo DMG gets the bonus.

abilities.name: Divine Maiden's Deliverance
_curatorNotes: Burst ActionSkill (E) defaults to InitAbilSlice value (100); gcsim labels this '// Q -> E' on the InitAbilSlice(100) line but makes no explicit ActionSkill assignment. Omitted per recipe rule. Reviewer to verify if E=100 was intentional.

Cryo + Physical RES shred authored 2026-07-28 (capability sweep): gcsim burst.go:113-122 applies both ResistMods (Value -burstrespp[TalentLvlBurst], re-applied every 18f to enemies inside the Talisman Spirit Field); shenhe_gen.go burstrespp[9] = 0.15 (TL10). Duration 12 = base field lifetime, onCast-burst-field shape per Jean C4 lands_of_dandelion. ↻ 2026-09-17 (T1.5): C2 extends the field to 18s and the shreds with it (gcsim re-applies them for the whole extended burstDuration) — a C2-gated 18s pair beside the 12s pair, since an Effect has no durationModifiers. Shred only affects enemies inside the field; corpus-standard approximation.
Deific Embrace (A1) cryo DMG bonus for active char within field is authored on the A1 passive, not here.
abilities.description:
Unleashes the power of the Talisman Spirit, allowing it to roam free in this plane, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
The Talisman Spirit then creates a field that decreases the Cryo RES and Physical RES of opponents within it. It also deals periodic Cryo DMG to opponents within the field.

passives.name: Deific Embrace
_curatorNotes: `manual` → `onCast burst`, `target: active` (2026-09-17, T1.5; was `manual` + `team`, which drew nothing and claimed the party). gcsim burst.go ticks every 18f while the field lives and gives the ACTIVE character inside it 15% Cryo DMG for 36f — so the bar is the field's life on whoever is on field (standing in the field is assumed). 12s, or 18s at C2 as a C2-gated twin; the constellation gate resolves before the active pass's stat dedupe, so the pair cannot collide.
passives.description: An active character within the field created by Divine Maiden's Deliverance gains 15% Cryo DMG Bonus.

constellations.name: Insight
_curatorNotes: C4 Skyfrost Mantra: when party members consume an Icy Quill stack (i.e. trigger the DMG Bonus), Shenhe gains a stack (max 50, lasts 60s; gcsim: c4count++, AddStatus(c4BuffKey, 3600)). On Shenhe's next E cast, all stacks are consumed and each adds 5% DMG Bonus to that cast (gcsim: c4() returns 0.05*c4count, injected into the E hit snapshot). This is a dynamic self-buff that accrues between casts — not modelable as a static buff entry. Not authored; reviewer to decide representation.
constellations.description:
When characters under the effect of Icy Quill applied by Shenhe trigger its DMG Bonus effects, Shenhe will gain a Skyfrost Mantra stack:
· When Shenhe uses Spring Spirit Summoning, she will consume all stacks of Skyfrost Mantra, increasing the DMG of that Spring Spirit Summoning by 5% for each stack consumed.
· Max 50 stacks. Stacks last for 60s.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't draw damage amounts, and this only raises how hard Shenhe's next Spring Spirit Summoning hits.
